verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no retention-period settings, auto-delete policies, or user controls for deleting recordings or transcripts. The closest items are a training opt-out for Enterprise (otter-docs-43) and audit logs (otter-docs-20). These are adjacent privacy controls, not retention or deletion control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
